_comment: run_31 = run_30 (block-3 settlement + single release + weak-Allee prior + juvenile-ratio prior) + DISEASE AS MORTALITY (disease_prior.target = survival): the epizootic adds mortality to adults and juveniles, m = 0.8 * modifier(x) * gate(t - onset) * (1 - r(t - onset)) * hill(current local density); r = host resistance/tolerance (rec, tau_rec); K disease-free and c from disease-free rates, so endemic mortality lowers the equilibrium below K.

Why (user + E019, 2026-10-16): the K-cut disease was a permanent capacity step (median 29%, east pinned at the 50% ceiling, no recovery) and could only crash populations as fast as adults die -- pushing Sa down and fecundity up. Real conjunctivitis kills birds; resistance evolved.
